caption: The drawing features a single metallic object resembling a vintage medical or scientific instrument centered on a light beige background. The object is shown in a realistic style and positioned diagonally, with one rounded loop handle at the upper left and another at the lower left, both attached to straight arms that converge at a pivot joint. From the pivot, two additional components project to the right: one appears flat and blade-like, curving upward, while the other is more cylindrical and scooped, ending in a slender, tapered point. The color palette consists mainly of shades of grey and black used to depict the metallic surface, with distinct highlights and shadows indicating a slightly worn texture. There are no other objects or background details except for the artist’s signature “Lee Brown” in the lower right corner.
title: Candle Snuffer
